# Alvagante

Alvagante is a compact personal dashboard for curated links and daily AI-assisted news digests. Public data is local-first and file-backed in this static Jekyll site.

## Primary Pages

- Home: https://alvagante.com/
- Link directory: https://alvagante.com/links/
- News digests: https://alvagante.com/news/
- Sitemap: https://alvagante.com/sitemap/
- RSS feed: https://alvagante.com/rss.xml

## Data Shape

- Curated links are grouped by topic and category.
- Daily news digests are generated from enabled RSS/Atom sources.
- News categories currently include AI, IT, and Science.

## Usage Notes

Use the public pages and RSS feed as the canonical interface. Do not assume there is a backend API, account system, comment system, or admin UI.
